name: datawright-agent-tools
description: Let your agent audit domains and websites: SPF/DMARC/DKIM, SSL and domain expiry, WHOIS/RDAP lookups (registrar, domain age, availability), HTTP security headers with an A-F grade, redirect chains and migration redirect checks, meta tags, Open Graph and schema.org checks, broken links, Core Web Vitals, screenshots and PDFs, sitemap URLs, keyword suggestions, App Store charts and ATS job feeds.
